visualCharacteristics.purpose: Embeds an Adobe Dynamic Media / Scene7 video viewer (e.g. SmartCropVideoViewer.html) in a responsive 16:9 iframe
visualCharacteristics.description: Scene7 SmartCropVideoViewer embed | Scene7 Dynamic Media viewer iframe (Smart Crop video) instead of YouTube/Vimeo

contentPattern.structure: single cell: the viewer URL as a link or bare text (query string configures the viewer and is kept as-is); optional poster image above the URL turns it into click-to-play
contentPattern.description: Third-party interactive media embed. visual-trees hint is default-content because the player had not rendered at capture (block was empty in DOM); source .plain.html has the viewer URL

usage: Dynamic Media video players and Scene7 HTML5 viewers.
reuseGuidance: Use for Scene7/DM viewer URLs. YouTube/Vimeo embeds belong in the library embed block.
